name: walkthrough
title: CI/CD and TDD for language projects: sprint velocity, red-green discipline, peer review triage, release checklist
description: This tour walks through the CI/CD and TDD tutorial: sprint health dashboard with velocity tracking, red-green test discipline with failing tests as sprint backlog, peer review feedback triage into FIX/DISCLOSE/FUTURE buckets, and a Demo Day release checklist automated as code.

steps.description: DATA dictionary defines three sprints with nodes planned/done, tests passing/total, sample programs running, and known failures. TOTAL_NODES = 18.
Loop over sprints computes velocity (nodes_done/nodes_planned), test percentage, and draws bar charts with # for done and . for remaining. Prints known failures.
Projection calculates remaining nodes, last sprint velocity, and sprints needed. Prints OK if complete, on track if <=1 sprint, WARNING if more.
Two rules: sprint with >2 known failures is not done; test_pct < 80% triggers test-debt sprint.
Sprint 1 velocity = 6/8 = 75%.

steps.question: What is the projection after Sprint 3?
steps.answer: All nodes complete! Ready for Demo Day polish.

steps.description: Remaining = 0, prints All nodes complete! Ready for Demo Day polish. OK
Move to red-green discipline.
IMPLEMENTED dictionary tracks 15 features with True/False. Features like NumLit, StrLit, BinOp_arith are True; WhileStmt, FunDecl, Call, ReturnStmt, LogicOp, StringConcat are False.
TESTS list maps 22 test descriptions to required features and expected outputs. Each test is (description, required_feature, expected_output).
passing filters TESTS where IMPLEMENTED[feature] is True. failing filters where False.
Prints PASSING tests with OK prefix, then FAILING tests with FAIL prefix and feature label in brackets.

steps.question: How many tests pass with 9 of 15 features implemented?

steps.description: Summary: 14/22 tests passing (64%). 8 failing tests remain.
8 tests still failing. Evaluate sprint scope with Coordinator.
Move to peer review triage.
FEEDBACK list of 12 cards from 4 sources (Team Amber, Cobalt, Jade, Instructor). Each card has type: strength, question, or risk.
triage_item(text) classifies risks/questions: crash words -> FIX, scope words -> FUTURE, else -> DISCLOSE.
Loop over FEEDBACK: strengths go to STRENGTH bucket; risks/questions get triaged into FIX, DISCLOSE, or FUTURE.

steps.question: How many items are classified as FIX?

steps.description: FIX items: function no return, REPL no parse recovery, nested calls crash, SEMANTICS.md mismatch. Each gets assignment blanks.
DISCLOSE items: while loop scoping question. Gets disclosure wording blank.
FUTURE items: pass function as argument. Printed with team and text.
Move to try-it-yourself triage.
New FEEDBACK with 7 cards from Team B, C, Instructor, Team D. Mix of strengths, risks, questions.
CLASSIFICATION dictionary manually maps 5 risk/question texts to FIX, DISCLOSE, or FUTURE.
Loop classifies using CLASSIFICATION.get(text, UNCLASSIFIED). Strengths collected separately.

steps.question: How many FIX items in the manual classification?

steps.description: FIX: parser crashes unclosed string, SEMANTICS.md scope mismatch, no while loop test. DISCLOSE: divide by zero. FUTURE: functions as arguments. UNCLASSIFIED: 0.
Backlog items to assign: 3. No UNCLASSIFIED warning.
Move to release checklist.
check(label, result, guidance) prints OK/FAIL with label, returns result. If FAIL and guidance exists, prints guidance with -> prefix.
Check 1: README.md or readme.md exists. Guidance: create with Python version, install steps, usage.
Check 2: sample_*.lang files count >= 5. Guidance: add sample_01 through sample_05, one shows niche.
Check 3: test_lang.py or tests.py exists. Guidance: create, run, commit passing output.
Check 4: SEMANTICS.md exists and >500 bytes. Guidance: must cover scoping, truthiness, division, strings, null policy.
Check 5: grammar.ebnf or GRAMMAR.md exists. Guidance: must match current implementation.
Check 6: main.py or lang.py exists. Guidance: both python main.py --repl and python main.py program.lang must work.
Check 7: py_compile on entry point returns 0. Guidance: run python -m py_compile on entry file.

steps.question: How many checks pass on a fresh repository with only main.py?

steps.description: Output shows 6 FAIL (README, samples, tests, SEMANTICS.md, grammar, syntax) and 1 OK (entry point). Total 1/7 passed.
